english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the enjoyment or pleasure you get from something.
This is the all-purpose noun for enjoyment or something enjoyable.
This is the all-purpose noun for something that brings enjoyment or happiness, such as the joys of parenthood.
This is the all-purpose noun for pleasure or an enjoyable thing, including an activity that gives someone pleasure.
This is the all-purpose noun for the fun or pleasure something gives.
Use this for the pleasure or amusement someone gets from something rather than for a physical kick.
Use this for fun or enjoyment in general rather than for a particular funny incident.
Use this when the source of satisfaction is an activity or experience that is enjoyable.

examples.english: This game is a lot of fun.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 hou2 jau5 lok6 ceoi3

examples.english: The greatest pleasure of travelling is meeting new friends.
examples.traditional: 旅行最大樂趣係識到新朋友。
